title: Core 13-Woman #09
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 16:9 aspect ratio, significantly wider than it is tall, thirteen women in a single row.

A photograph of THIRTEEN women standing side by side in a single row at the same ground level on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, each woman in her own distinct pose, generous horizontal spacing between each so every figure reads clearly and large within the frame, all real photographic skin with visible pores, no illustration finish, no CG sheen, all faces, hands and feet in correct proportion. The camera set back so all 13 fit comfortably within the wide frame from head to toe, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render. Exactly 13 women, no more, no fewer.

Piercings: 100pc studs/diamonds/mixed metal/sym. Jewellery: well over ten pieces, an extreme maximalist stack of platinum a ring. Pose: leaning against a wall just out of frame. Shoes: extreme ochre platform stiletto heels.
